# ViraStack AI (full)

> `@virastack/ai` (~1.3.1) — injects high-discipline agent rules and architecture docs into a React project. Framework-aware (Next.js vs TanStack Start). Not a chat UI library.

## Install

```bash
npx @virastack/ai init
```

Product: https://virastack.com/ai — Index: https://virastack.com/ai/llms.txt — Repo: https://github.com/virastack/ai

## CLI flags

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--force`, `-f` | Overwrite existing rule files without prompting |
| `--framework nextjs\|tanstack` | Force framework instead of detecting from `package.json` |
| `--tr` | Turkish CLI prompts and success messages |

## What gets written

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `AGENTS.md` | Agent operating guide (all agents) |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Claude Code entry point (`@AGENTS.md`) |
| `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` | Scoped coding rules (Cursor auto-loads) |
| `docs/architecture-guide.md` | Placement rules and import conventions |
| `docs/MEMORIES.md` | Project memory template |

## Rule coverage (typical)

- Architecture: core principles, feature boundaries, React best practices
- Data & state: TanStack Query (`queryOptions` factories), Zustand, API & error normalization (`ApiError`)
- UI & performance: UI components, Tailwind, forms, Core Web Vitals
- Quality: TypeScript strictness, testing expectations
- Smart isolation: only injects rules for the detected framework to reduce cross-framework hallucinations

## Critical rules encoded for agents (summary)

- Feature-Sliced boundaries: no cross-feature imports; Zod-first validation at API edges
- Prefer TanStack Query `queryOptions` factories over ad-hoc query keys
- Safe return / normalized errors (`ApiError` with `message`, `status`, `data`)
- Multi-agent ready: same standards via `AGENTS.md` + `CLAUDE.md` + Cursor rules

## Relationship to Start

`npx virastack@latest` scaffolds can install AI automatically (`--tools ai`). Inside an existing repo, run `npx @virastack/ai init` (use `--force` to refresh).

Design skills commonly referenced alongside AI in Start templates:

- https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills
- https://github.com/jakubkrehel/make-interfaces-feel-better
